statement: lambda_FB = N(E_F)*g0^2*Q_geom/(M*omega^2), Q_geom = FS-avg Bloch overlap in [1/N_band, 1]. PREDICTION: quantum geometry SUPPRESSES lambda -> a real flat-band SC shows lambda BELOW the naive Hopfield/Allen-Dynes value scaled from its (large) N(E_F).

test_design.naive_expectation: Hopfield: lambda ~ N(E_F)*<I^2>/(M*<omega^2>). For a fixed coupling+phonon backbone, a flat-band material's large N(E_F) (van Hove / kagome flat band) should drive a LARGE lambda. The law predicts the OPPOSITE: Q_geom < 1 (Bloch states spread over many sublattice components reduce the FS-averaged el-ph matrix overlap), depleting lambda below the N(E_F)-naive value.
test_design.signature_present: lambda noticeably BELOW what N(E_F) alone predicts; lambda DECOUPLED from N(E_F) (large N(E_F) but only moderate/weak lambda); lambda grows MUCH slower than N(E_F) under tuning.
test_design.control_group: Conventional H-cage hydrides (X2MH6, M3XH8, AXH8): NO flat band, dispersive sigma/H-octahedra states (Q_geom ~ 1). Expect lambda LARGE and tracking N(E_F).

materials.flat_band_near_Ef: yes (Ru-4d dx2-y2 kagome flat band ~55 meV of E_F; confirmed in repo gatecheck)
materials.suppression_verdict: PRESENT (cleanest tuning evidence). Ge-doping RAISES N(E_F) by 13.8% but lambda by only 4.1% -- lambda grows ~3x SLOWER than N(E_F). The flat-band DOS does NOT translate into proportional lambda; coupling is MODE-SELECTIVE (only Ru-B3u phonons couple to the flat band), exactly the Q_geom<1 depletion the law predicts. NOTE: our repo's coarse-grid lambda=1.64 is a soft upper bound from a dynamically-UNSTABLE 2x2x2 q-grid (imaginary modes dropped) -- the published converged DFT value is 0.635.

materials.structure_type: kagome (Os kagome, CeCo3B2-type, Os 5d isoelectronic to Ru 4d)
materials.flat_band_near_Ef: yes (Os-5d kagome flat band near E_F; repo sibling gatecheck)
materials.suppression_verdict: PRESENT (relative). N(E_F)=42.7 states/spin/Ry is LARGER than LaRu3Si2's 35.4, yet matched-sigma lambda is LOWER (0.811 vs LaRu3Si2's 1.64 at the same coarse grid). Higher flat-band DOS -> LOWER lambda = anti-Hopfield, the suppression signature. (Both repo values are coarse-grid soft upper bounds, d6.)

materials.structure_type: CONTROL: conventional H-cage (Au-H octahedra, cubic 216-type, NO flat band)
materials.flat_band_near_Ef: no (van Hove peak at W but dispersive sigma/octahedral-breathing states; Q_geom ~ 1)
materials.suppression_verdict: ABSENT (expected -- this is the control). No flat band, lambda is HUGE (2.84) and tracks N(E_F)/coupling conventionally. Confirms that large N(E_F) WITHOUT a flat band gives large lambda. The contrast with the kagome flat-band cases is the whole point.
materials.source: arXiv:2501.12222 (2025), High-Tc in Li2AuH6 mediated by strong el-ph
